briefing: Markets were mildly risk-on today (NASDAQ +0.7%, S&P 500 +0.5%), but available cash of $189.29 is below the $500 threshold needed to responsibly open a new position, so no new buys were made. All 7 existing positions were held unchanged, with stop-loss (-7%) and profit-target (+12%) rules continuing to run automatically.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept in reserve so you can act when a strong opportunity appears, rather than investing it just because it's sitting idle. Today the portfolio's cash balance ($189.29) is below the $500 minimum needed to open a new position responsibly, so it's better to hold and wait than to force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留現金，待出現真正好機會時才出手，而非因為現金閒置就勉強投資。今日組合現金餘額（$189.29）低於開新倉所需的$500最低門檻，因此持有現金等待比勉強交易更為明智。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices posted modest gains today, with the NASDAQ up 0.7% and the S&P 500 up 0.5%, reflecting a mild risk-on tone across the market. No major index-moving headlines were flagged for this session. The move was broad but not dramatic, consistent with a steady rather than euphoric trading day.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數均錄得溫和升幅，納斯達克指數升0.7%，標普500指數升0.5%，市場呈現輕微的風險偏好情緒。今個交易時段未有重大影響指數走勢的新聞。升勢屬普遍性但幅度溫和，反映市場氣氛穩健而非亢奮。
